notes:
Use-case: outbound SDR/chat agent that can execute CRM/email/calendar actions (HubSpot API, Gmail, Google Calendar). Primary focus: low-latency streaming + reliable tool-calling. Targets: initial-token/streaming latency target ~<200-250ms, end-to-end action execution <500ms for common flows; concurrency target 100-200 active agents during peak. Cost sensitivity: mid-market budget, want hosted for quick POC then convert to Dedicated if latency and unit economics check out.

Technical prefs: prefer Redwood-hosted API for speed of integration and built-in streaming; open to Dedicated for predictable throughput and VPC if we commit. Need function/tool calling patterns for: 1) pull CRM context, 2) propose next-email content, 3) send email / schedule meeting via calendar - all audited. Must have SSO (SAML) + SOC2 + KMS and audit logging. Data residency conversation in legal (EU customers).

POC scope: 2-week hosted API POC with streaming + tool-calling flows (HubSpot demo workspace). Success metrics: median first-token latency <250ms, 95p end-to-end action latency <500ms, error rate for tool calls <1%, quality metrics (human eval) >= baseline. If POC meets perf + quality, commercial asks to evaluate Dedicated commit tiers.

CTO Rajiv - "Can't have delays when SDRs are on live calls; latency kills conversion." SE Daniel - running perf matrix and will pull traces during POC.
